banner.title: The UA promotion batch one - rounds R333 through R348 complete - the Unearthed Arcana set open
banner.provenance: The UA promotion arc round one, the first rules promotion batch from the Unearthed Arcana pin rounds: thirteen records promoted into content/rules/ua/ - rounds R333 through R348 complete (the ranger and cavalier expansions, the thief-acrobat and the new-class bars, the weapon and the comeliness reads, the clerical spell blocks, the cantrips), one record per round per the OA header-record doctrine (the pin header stays the adjudicated record; the multi-header rounds merge their headers' pools), 970 model items (consts, bools, switches, chains), every record parsed back and compared equal (the lossless proof), the audit conditions converted to bad-detector examples. This batch is 304979 bytes of Lua. Cumulative thirteen of the 76-round UA set, 63 rounds remaining.
